basic_info.description: Sweet & updated single family home in Noe Valley on a double lot! This fully detached home welcomes beaming morning sun, a practical layout, and an impressive 50 foot wide garden. The living spaces offer an ample sized living room with an original fireplace, a fully remodeled kitchen with new cabinetry & appliances, and a dining area. Across the hall are three spacious bedrooms with lovely light, one updated bathroom, and a linen closet. The primary bedroom features sliding doors leading to a walkout deck opening to the massive garden where creativity awaits - endless gardening, entertaining, a play space for kids, or potential ADU/office workspace. The backyard also presents a garden shed  for creative endeavors, or addition storage, and a gated parking pad at the back of the lot allowing up to three car parking, another rarity for this Noe Valley home. Don't miss this unique opportunity to own a home on over 5,000 square feet of land to be enjoyed as-is or developed in the future.
